simple: the one small function an all-reduce uses to talk to its neighbours, so the same algorithm can run over threads, MPI, GPU copies or RDMA.
analogy: the hatch between two kitchen halls: the cooks do not care whether a runner, a belt or a van carries the bowl through it.
precise: in MP5, Link<T>::sendRecv(send, ns, recv, nr) sends ns elements to rank r + 1 and receives nr elements from rank r - 1, returning a status (ok, timeout, aborted); the ring algorithm calls nothing else, so new transports change nothing above the interface.
source: R1, R4 of MP5 (lab runs in this build) — pending verification (dossier gate G1 open)

simple: the exact number of elements each rank must send in one all-reduce; sending more or fewer is a bug even if the answer looks right.
analogy: every hall must pass exactly so many bowls per evening; a hall that passed fewer skipped somebody.
precise: with segment lengths |seg_g| (g = 0 ... N - 1) and N >= 2, rank r of a ring all-reduce sends 2·count - |seg_(r+1)| - |seg_(r+2)| elements (indices mod N); the maximum over ranks approaches the bandwidth-optimal 2(N - 1)/N · count. Checked exactly by the MP5 suite.
source: D1 of MP5 (Patarasuk and Yuan, title only) and R1, R2 of MP5 — pending verification (dossier gate G1 open)

simple: the percentage of the reference library's speed you promise to reach, written down before you measure.
analogy: naming the time you will beat before the race, not after.
precise: the 'X %' of the curriculum's performance acceptance tests, fixed in the plan and approved at gate R1 of a mega project; it is never lowered afterwards without the owner's explicit approval and a log entry (curriculum 13.4).
source: C1 of MP5 (Systems Curriculum 13.4, a map) — pending verification

simple: a report that puts what the cost model predicted next to what you measured, size by size, and explains every difference.
analogy: the delivery plan's estimated times next to the drivers' real times, with a reason for every late van.
precise: the MP5 deliverable in which alpha and beta are fitted or measured per link class, predictions for every message size, layout and back-end are tabulated against medians of repeated measurements, the ratio predicted/measured is reported, and each region outside the tolerance agreed at R1 has an evidence-backed cause.
source: C2 of MP5 (guide 11.6, MP5 card) and R5 of MP5 — pending verification

simple: when an all-reduce is stopped half-way, the data buffers hold a mix of partial sums and must not be used.
analogy: a pot that was half-way through being combined when service stopped: cook again from the saved ingredients, do not serve it.
precise: after any rank's collective returns an error, every rank's buffer is treated as undefined; recovery runs a new communicator on inputs saved before the call or on the last checkpoint. In the MP5 starter lab, re-running on aborted buffers gives values outside the error bound.
source: R3 of MP5 (lab run in this build) — pending verification
